viewer.description: Present only when the viewer parameter was supplied.

homeSlug.description: The note shown as the wiki's front page, as the wiki record's homeSlug names it.

createdAt.description: The wiki record's own timestamp, in UTC. An unreadable or future-dated stamp falls back to our ingest time.

noteCount.description: How many notes listNotes returns. A note counts once its first revision is ingested.

updatedAt.description: When this appview last saw the wiki or a note in it change. Observed locally, so appviews may legitimately disagree.

did.description: Owner of the wiki. Use with slug.

uri.description: AT-URI of the wiki record. Supply this, or did and slug.

slug.description: The wiki's slug, which is also its record key. Use with did.

viewer.description: Ask what this DID can do with the wiki. Check it before writing, because ingest keeps a revision only from a DID that can edit and drops the rest silently.

main.description: Get a wiki. Pass viewer to also get what that DID can do with it. Public wikis only. Takes a DID, so resolve a handle to one first with com.atproto.identity.resolveHandle.

role.description: Present when the DID owns the wiki or holds a membership.

canWrite.description: Whether a wiki.lichen.noteRevision written by this DID would be accepted.
